newsitem.title: SYRIA: SYRIA TENDERS TO BUY 26,000 TONNES RAW/WHITE SUGAR.
newsitem.headline: SYRIA TENDERS TO BUY 26,000 TONNES RAW/WHITE SUGAR.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, a GEZA spokesman said on Thursday.
He said September 9 was set as final date to receive price offers and that the two amounts should be shipped in October. Results of the tender would be made on September 10, the official said.
A GEZA tender issued on Wednesday to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 20 was still valid.
The official on Thursday also said GEZA has bought 13,000 tonnes of white sugar at $374.70 per tonne from France's Lorico and delivery would be in September.
He said a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar which was due for GEZA's answer on Aug 6 was cancelled as price offers did not meet GEZA's conditions.
